content.comment_body: Hello. Is it possible to access a personal web page directly by entering its address, without first passing through the initial logo and password page? Would this require a digital certificate? Thank you.

Hello, a user-defined login page requires [product_name] [version_no]. To add a login page, go to 'Project', position the cursor on 'Pages', then right-click to add a custom login page. Only specific controls can be used on a login page. I'm not sure if this feature works only with recent [product_name] versions or also with earlier ones.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is interested in bypassing the initial logo and password entry screen to directly access their personal web page. Another contributor explained that a custom login page can be created using [product_name] [version_no], but only certain controls are permitted and there may be version limitations. The discussion highlights the enforced initial security step and an interest in more efficient access.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to skip the standard login splash page and access the personal web page directly, possibly using secure methods like digital certificates.
